Inday Sara’s Way: Technicalities Over Truth

Whether it’s defending her father in The Hague or protecting herself in Manila, Sara Duterte only knows one tactic: escape through technicality, never through truth. Kasi kapag totoo ang basehan, talo siya. Kaya ang palusot: legal. Hindi moral. Hindi factual.

1. ICC: Her Father’s Arrest Proves the Case Is Real: Defense Proves She's Desperate

Since March 2025, Rodrigo Duterte has been under arrest and detained sa The Hague, charged with crimes against humanity.
Alam ng lahat kung sino ang isa sa nagdidikta sa kampo niya: Sara Duterte.
Behind the scenes, she’s the strategist. She’s the real power. Why? Dahil gamit na gamit niya ang nangyari sa Tatay niya para sa ambisyon nya sa 2028 Presidential elections. 

Instead of facing the facts , like the sworn testimonies of whistleblowers including Arturo Lascañas and several victims. anong ginawa nila?

They challenged jurisdiction. They questioned process. They filed motions para palitan ang judges o ang prosecutors. Why? Because even Sara knows: “Masyado nang malakas ang ebidensya. Kailangan tumagal ang proseso upang mai-load niya sa victim card niya ang nangyayari sa tatay nya. 

Simple lang, if mahina ang ebidensya laban kay Duterte, dapat hindi nagdedelay ang kampo nya. Ang mga motions at pagkontra sa korte ay maaaring magpabagal sa proseso ng paglilitis.

2. Impeachment: noong siya naman ang nasa sitwasyon, Tumatakbo rin Siya sa Technicality

Nung siya naman ang nabanatan ng impeachment complaint dito sa Pilipinas, Sara pulled exactly the same move. Walang sagot. Walang paliwanag. Instead, she ran to the Supreme Court to block the process. At inutusan ang kanyang mga kampon sa senado na i-delay at tuluyang harangin ang impeachment trial. 

At syempre, sino ang nasa Supreme Court?
Majority appointees ni Rodrigo Duterte.

Guess what happened?
She got what she wanted. The case was killed not with facts, but with connections.

Senators aligned with Duterte defended her, no questions asked. Because that’s the strategy: Control the institutions. Evade the truth. Hold on power hanggang 2028. 

3. One Pattern. One Sara. Zero Integrity.
• In the ICC: the Duterte camp avoids facts by attacking the court.
• In the impeachment: she avoids accountability by blocking the process.
• In both cases: she doesn’t defend innocence. She defends privilege and This is cowardice in high heels.

4. The gly Truth: Sara is Not Fighting for Justice. She’s Fighting to Survive.
When her father is in jail, when her own name is under fire, when truth threatens her name, anong ginawa niya? 
Sheweaponize technicalities.
She manipulate institutions.
She act like a victim while silencing the real ones.
And worse, she make it look legal, even if it’s morally bankrupt.

5. Same Sara, Same Script
No https://t.co/7wICJp0rx7 courage. Walang hiya. 

The more she hides behind technicalities, the more obvious the guilt.

Bottomline:
Sara Duterte doesn’t face accusations with truth she buries them with technivalities and connections. And in both The Hague and the House of Representatives, the truth keeps knocking: but she keeps running.

Gold Pulls Back After Powell’s Dovish Signals

Gold futures slip Monday, trimming Friday’s rally sparked by Powell’s dovish Jackson Hole comments.

🪙 Gold Market Update
– CTAs rotate into Treasuries, away from USD (BofA)
– Profit-taking after test of $3,400
– Support: $3,250 | Resistance: $3,400 (needs catalysts)
– Senator Murkowski visits Alaska’s Estelle mine, highlighting gold’s strategic role

📈 Equity Trends
Winners:
– U.S. (Dow +1.89%) & Brazil (+2.57%) — commodities & consumer sectors
– Israel (+1.34%), Saudi Arabia (+0.35%)
– Europe: Germany (+0.32%), France (+0.40%), Sweden (+1.62%) despite Portugal (-0.50%)

Risks:
– India (-0.85%) & Australia (-0.57%) — commodity weakness
– Equity inflows slow as tech correction fears grow

Trend:
– Canada & Brazil gain from weaker USD
– Gold miners stay in focus, but Barrick earnings weigh

🪙 Crypto vs Gold
– Philippines eyes state crypto reserves
– Economist Harry Dent warns of crash from overheated markets
– Gold demand steady as Asian & Middle Eastern CBs diversify
– Takeaway: Crypto = speculative; Gold = risk hedge

🔭 What to Watch
– EU & U.S. inflation data
– Fed guidance: dovish tone supports gold

📌 Recommendations
– Gold: Consolidation $3,250–$3,400; buy dips
– Long-term: $3,500+ if Fed stays dovish
– Equities: Favor Canada, Brazil; selective on miners
– Crypto: High risk, correction likely

Key Question:
Can gold hold gains post-Jackson Hole? If inflation stays contained and Fed dovish — yes. Otherwise, correction resumes.
